rule: B2: every column is added optional and non-unique. Required and enforce-unique are switched on in Phase 6.

lists.title: Portal Sequence Counters
lists.note: No new column. Counter rows for TASK and FILE are created by the first claim of each year (identification kit).

lists.title: Flow Configuration
lists.note: Receives the ENVIRONMENT_CODE and DATASET_* rows.

lists.title: DGO_UserDirectory
lists.note: No new column. UserId must hold the Entra object ID; the verifier lists rows whose UserId is not a GUID.

lists.title: DGO_HTTPFlowRegistry
lists.note: Provisioned by the governance registry provisioner (npm run test:governanceregistryprovisioner); not by this plan.

lists.title: DGO_HTTPFlowDependencies
lists.note: Provisioned by the governance registry provisioner; not by this plan.

rows.Title: ENVIRONMENT_CODE
rows.note: prd in production; uat or dev elsewhere. If missing, the kit issues Z-prefixed references.
